description: This Java class manages persistence of expectations to the filesystem for the MockServer framework. It serializes expectations to a file, handles file locking, and listens for updates to trigger persistence.

classes.name: ExpectationFileSystemPersistence
classes.description: Manages persistence of expectations to filesystem, serializing data, handling file locks, and listening for updates.

methods.name: ExpectationFileSystemPersistence
methods.description: Constructor initializing persistence settings, creating file if necessary, and registering listener.

methods.name: updated
methods.description: Handles updates to request matchers, serializes expectations, and writes to file with locking.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a list of expectations to JSON string.
